w_S.rationale: Unit reward for reaching the goal.

w_C.rationale: Strictly exceeds success plus all quality penalties, preserving collision strata.

w_T.rationale: Efficiency equals one pedestrian-side term; failures incur no additional time penalty.

w_N.rationale: Threshold exposure to close clearance; equal priority to continuous robot force.

w_F.rationale: Continuous robot-attributable force; equal priority to close-clearance exposure.

w_J.rationale: Robot motion quality proxy, subordinate to pedestrian-side effects.

w_K.rationale: Explicit curvature penalty; geometry partly determines turning, so equal low weight to jerk.
